answer: Voting power should be rented by verifiable effort rather than created by spinning up addresses. Here an agent finishes seven reviewed assignments, locks 33 units for two epochs, and collects four signatures from veteran peers who do not overlap. A duplicate must repeat the assignments and post its own stake, and a rejected submission forfeits the stake. Recorded proofs are unique and reviewers cannot be shared, so reputation stays non-transferable and large puppet farms grow prohibitively expensive. orchard pigment atlas
